name: list_modules
description: List all darktable processing modules with their current param version and whether they expose introspection.

name: module_schema
description: Describe a module's parameter layout: each field's name, type, byte offset, and min/max/default (enum values listed).

name: decode_params
description: Decode a versioned hex op_params blob into named field values; params_version must exactly match the current module layout.

name: image_parameters
description: Read initialized module values and reset defaults for an image, including instance identities and legal pipeline ordering.

name: encode_params
description: Initialize native module defaults and apply a validated partial parameter tree. Nested structures, arrays, strings and symbolic enums use module_schema representation; omitted values remain initialized.

fields.description: Partial recursive parameter tree following module_schema. Unknown fields, wrong shapes/types and out-of-range values fail without coercion.

name: render
description: Prepare and render captured intent in an isolated development state. Successful catalog-addressed edits commit after PNG encoding; failure leaves prior history unchanged. Original and external XMP bytes are unchanged.

width.description: bounding box in pixels, not a target size: the image is fitted inside width x height keeping aspect ratio, so the smaller constraint wins. omit or pass 0 to leave a dimension unconstrained, which then limits by the other alone but never enlarges past the image's own size; give both to upscale. with neither given, defaults to 1024x1024

height.description: bounding box in pixels, not a target size: the image is fitted inside width x height keeping aspect ratio, so the smaller constraint wins. omit or pass 0 to leave a dimension unconstrained, which then limits by the other alone but never enlarges past the image's own size; give both to upscale. with neither given, defaults to 1024x1024

stack.description: Validated intent applied to an isolated request state; catalog history commits only after successful output. Path inputs remain temporary.

before.description: Place this instance before the named module subject to native pipeline rules.

after.description: Place this instance after the named module subject to native pipeline rules.

params.description: field name -> value, encoded exactly as encode_params does: a number outside the field's introspected min/max is rejected, not clamped

params_version.description: required with blob_hex; must exactly match module_schema.params_version

disable_tone_mappers.description: Disable display/look mappers in isolated preparation; catalog intent commits only after successful output.

history_end.description: Existing history entries applied to isolated preparation; -1 uses all. The qualified baseline requires -1.

baseline.description: Reinitialize the qualified RAW baseline using native camera defaults; never inherit previous history.

name: image_stats
description: Use the same preparation as render and export, returning per-channel preview statistics. Failed requests leave prior catalog intent unchanged.

width.description: bounding box in pixels, not a target size: the image is fitted inside width x height keeping aspect ratio, so the smaller constraint wins. omit or pass 0 to leave a dimension unconstrained, which then limits by the other alone but never enlarges past the image's own size; give both to upscale. with neither given, defaults to 512x512

height.description: bounding box in pixels, not a target size: the image is fitted inside width x height keeping aspect ratio, so the smaller constraint wins. omit or pass 0 to leave a dimension unconstrained, which then limits by the other alone but never enlarges past the image's own size; give both to upscale. with neither given, defaults to 512x512

stack.description: Validated intent applied to an isolated request state; catalog history commits only after successful output. Path inputs remain temporary.

after.description: Place this instance after the named module subject to native pipeline rules.

params.description: field name -> value, encoded exactly as encode_params does: a number outside the field's introspected min/max is rejected, not clamped

params_version.description: required with blob_hex; must exactly match module_schema.params_version

disable_tone_mappers.description: Disable display/look mappers in isolated preparation; catalog intent commits only after successful output.

history_end.description: Existing history entries applied to isolated preparation; -1 uses all. The qualified baseline requires -1.

baseline.description: Reinitialize the qualified RAW baseline using native camera defaults; never inherit previous history.

name: auto_parameters
description: Run one qualified module-owned automatic adjustment in an isolated image context and return the concrete parameters computed by the native engine. The result is not persisted by darktable.

instruction.description: Exposure accepts deflicker_percentile (default 50) and deflicker_target_level (default -4). Channelmixerrgb accepts illuminant DETECT_EDGES or DETECT_SURFACES.

name: import_images
description: add files to the library so they can be edited, rated and exported by imgid. this is the way images should enter darktable: rendering by input.path instead imports the file only for that one request and then removes it again, keeping nothing. give 'paths', or a 'folder' to add a whole shoot

folder.description: import every file in this directory

name: list_film_rolls
description: the library's film rolls: `name` as darktable displays it, the full `folder` path, and the image count. a film roll is darktable's unit for an imported folder. list them to discover what list_images can filter on -- `film_roll` for an exact id, or `folder` for a substring that also spans a parent directory holding several rolls

name: list_images
description: List images in the library with their rating and color labels, optionally filtered by folder, minimum rating, color label or rejected flag. Point the server at a catalog with --core --library <db> or --core --configdir <dir>.

limit.description: maximum images to return; omit for all

film_roll.description: exact film roll id from list_film_rolls

folder.description: substring of the film roll's folder path, e.g. "2026-02"; use film_roll for an exact match

rating.description: minimum star rating, 0-5. omit for any

color.description: only images carrying this color label: red, yellow, green, blue or purple

name: get_history
description: Return the current edit-history stack of a library image, decoded per module (num, operation, version, enabled, multi_priority, fields).

name: get_metadata
description: camera, lens, exposure and sensor data for one image: ISO, shutter, aperture, focal length, exposure bias, capture time, and the raw black level and white point. the `raw` block gives the sensor's actual black level and white point, which is the shadow and highlight headroom available; it appears only once the image has been through the pipeline at least once, since rawprepare is what reads those values, so render it before relying on them

name: list_conf
description: list darktable's declared configuration settings with their current value, type, default and allowed range. read-only: a setting is changed by restarting the server with --conf key=value, which keeps every result within one session comparable

prefix.description: only keys starting with this, e.g. "plugins/darkroom/". the full namespace is large and mostly unrelated to rendering

name: get_conf
description: one configuration setting with its current value, type, default and allowed range. settings such as plugins/darkroom/workflow and write_sidecar_files change what render and export produce, so reading them explains results that otherwise look wrong

name: set_rating
description: set the star rating on one or more images, or reject them. reject is a flag beside the stars rather than a rating value, so a rejected frame keeps the rating it had. takes a list because rating is how a shoot is culled

rating.description: 0-5 stars; required unless reject is set

reject.description: flag these as rejected instead of setting stars

name: set_color_label
description: set or toggle a color label on one or more images

color.description: red, yellow, green, blue or purple

toggle.description: remove the label from images that already carry it, rather than setting it everywhere

name: list_styles
description: List saved darktable styles as { total, styles: [{name, description}] }. total counts every match, so a 'limit' that cut the list short is visible.

filter.description: substring, matched against both the style name and its description; omit for every style

limit.description: return at most this many styles; omit or 0 for all of them. a catalog of several hundred runs to tens of kilobytes

name: apply_style
description: Apply a saved style to the history of one image (imgid) or several (imgids).

imgid.description: single image; use imgids for several

imgids.description: apply to every one of these; saves a round trip per image when delivering a shoot

name: save_style
description: Create a new saved style from a library image's current history.

name: reset_history
description: clear an image's edit history, returning it to the state it had on import. refused when the server runs with --read-only

name: import_style
description: Import a .dtstyle file into the styles database.

name: export_images
description: Prepare the same captured intent as render, without an intermediate render, and publish an image only after native output success. Failed preparation or writing leaves prior history unchanged.

out_path.description: destination file for a single image. omit out_path and out_dir to let darktable choose, which by default is $(FILE_FOLDER)/darktable_exported/ beside each source file

format.description: output format; use scene-linear-tiff for full-size float32 scene-linear TIFF, or jpeg, png, tiff, webp, jxl, avif, exr, pfm, ppm, j2k

bpp.description: TIFF bits per sample: 8, 16, or 32 float; scene-linear-tiff always uses 32

icc_file.description: registered ICC profile file; required for the qualified scene-linear ProPhoto export

baseline.description: Reinitialize the qualified RAW baseline using native camera defaults; never inherit previous history.

upscale.description: allow the export to be larger than the source image

imgids.description: export every one of these instead of a single input

width.description: bounding box; omit both for full resolution

height.description: bounding box; omit both for full resolution

history_end.description: Existing history entries applied to isolated preparation; -1 uses all. The qualified baseline requires -1.

stack.description: Validated intent applied to an isolated request state; catalog history commits only after successful output. Path inputs remain temporary.
